title: matricaria trichophylla
intro: Matricaria trichophylla, commonly known as Western Yarrow, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antispasmodic properties, making it a popular remedy for soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and alleviating menstrual cramps. The therapeutic actions of Western Yarrow are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, volatile oils, and sesquiterpene lactones, such as chamazulene and matricine, that exhibit antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory activities. Western Yarrow is often used in traditional medicine to promote relaxation, improve sleep quality, and support the immune system.
